entries.description: Registered S1; archived the 2026-08-05 seat probe as probe-evidence-copilot-catalog.lock (11/18 confirmed, three provider families) plus a provenance README; journaled the D:-unavailable source substitution.

Authored s1-kill-inventory.md from a fresh git-grep of 13 terms across 3,851 tracked files: 611 mention the tier, 461 are archives/proposals (exempt), 150 live. Found and journaled the env-var gate escape (DABBLER_NO_ROUTER alone disarms two Full-tier close gates) that the spec kill list did not name.

Deleted Mode A + Mode B whole: dedicated_verification, external_verification, pending_verification, change_verification_mode, migrate_lightweight_to_canonical_v4 (2,581 lines) and their 7 test modules; removed both close-out gate blocks, the typed-session CLI/writer path in start_session, and the lightweight-to-v4 migrator from the chain + shipped manifest.

runtime_mode.py rewritten to two sources (CLI flag, env var); _spec_tier/_spec_says_lightweight deleted; session_set_dir kept as an ignored signature-stable arg. Removed the gate escapes in gate_checks._set_is_lightweight and close_session (verification-integrity + run-of-record freshness no longer disarmed by an env var), and the --no-router self-attestation.

spec_config raises LightweightTierRemovedError (ValueError subclass) on tier: lightweight inside the canonical config block, carrying a one-line migration message naming tier: full, the DABBLER_* keys, the copilot-cli profile, and the notice doc. Prose mentions and non-canonical fences stay inert so archives remain readable.

Deleted test-fixtures/cold-start/lightweight/ and dropped the tier from the TS golden-snapshot render matrix and the Python cold-start acceptance parameterisation. Recorded s1-before-after-numbers.md: 3,811 -> 3,578 tests (-233), 4,404 production lines removed, and the MEASURED finding that the CI-minutes saving is ~0 (the deleted modules cost 3.64s of a 957s suite) rather than the shrinkage the spec assumed.

Post-freeze runs of record: pytest 3,565 passed / 0 failed / 9 skipped (16m18s); Layer 3 Playwright 33 passed / 0 failed (9m0s) -- required because this session edited three blessed writers (session_state, start_session, close_session) that the freshness map covers. drift_guard and tutorial_gate both clean; extension compiles.

Cross-provider verification (gpt-5.5, anthropic excluded): discovery fan-out 2 -> 3 Major; supplementary -> 1 Major; all 4 accepted and fixed (boundary refusal in both lifecycle CLIs + _uat_policy re-raise + quoted-YAML gap, close-out.md, extension bulk-upgrade chain); remediation-review VERIFIED, 4 fixes accepted 0 rejected. Post-fix runs of record: pytest 3,576 passed / 9 skipped; Layer 3 33 passed.
Registered S2; read preload, spec, S1 kill inventory and disposition; confirmed copilot-cli transport
Scoped the S2 remainder: 52 extension src/media files, 57 extension test/fixture files, 12 templates, 35 docs prose files
Scoped the S2 remainder from s1-kill-inventory.md: extension src/media, extension tests/fixtures, docs/templates, docs prose

Getting Started form: tier radio group and the Lightweight verification-mode block deleted; provider access is the first question. 7 extension modules deleted whole; types/protocol/scan layer/ActionRegistry/package.json contributions trimmed
consumer-bootstrap + sample-project templates render one tier; cold-start/full golden regenerated from the templates
Collapsing teaching docs to the one-tier story; tier-model.md to a historical note; drift guard retirement

Teaching docs tell one story: workflow doc lost its 383-line Lightweight verification section and typed-session procedure; constitution, spec-md-schema, session-state-schema, authoring guide, quick-start, README collapsed; tier-model.md is now a historical note; the drift guard retired its stale-framing check and kept its doc-walk mechanism for S3
Authored docs/cross-repo-lightweight-removal-notice.md (send is operator-gated); marked the Set 048 Lightweight notice superseded
Running Layer 1 pytest and Layer 2 extension unit suites

Layer 1 pytest 3,561 passed / 9 skipped; Layer 2 mocha 1,602 passing; Layer 3 Playwright 33 passed incl. the rewritten tier-fork-is-gone assertion and the real first-run walkthrough. drift_guard and tutorial_gate both exit 0. All three runs of record recorded
Committing S2 and running cross-provider verification

Committed and pushed S2; cross-provider verification (gpt-5.5, anthropic excluded): discovery found 2 Major (both = the Marketplace README was never collapsed), supplementary found nothing new, remediation-review VERIFIED with 1 fix accepted / 0 rejected
Authoring disposition and closing session 2
close_session succeeded: all 8 gates PASS. Round 4 re-verification VERIFIED against the final tree after the close-out writes; close backstop EvidenceTooLargeError crash fixed en route
Registered session 3 (copilot/anthropic/claude-opus-5, effort high); committed S2 close-out state; read preload + spec + S1 inventory + ai-assignment notes

Authoring the anti-resurrection gate: surveyed all live references per pattern; every remaining hit is narration (comment/docstring/prose), so the gate encodes declaration-territory vs narration-territory structurally rather than an file allowlist

Shipped ai_router/scripts/lightweight_resurrection_guard.py + 41 falsifier tests + CI wiring. Gate classifies by position (declaration territory vs narration), not a file allowlist. It caught 2 real defects: cross-repo-migration-guard-notice.md still told consumers to run the deleted migrator, and the superseded Set 048 notice did too. Also fixed 3 stale claims: session-constitution.md named verificationMode as a live gate record, fileSystem.ts kept a dead activityLogParsed binding, upgradeOlderSets.ts said three migrators

Staged the breaking release: router 0.34.0 -> 1.0.0 (pyproject + __init__), CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cut to [1.0.0] with a BREAKING banner + the S3 gate entry; extension 0.49.0 -> 0.50.0 with a Set 112 section superseding the never-published 0.49.0; repository-reference release-status rows updated. Publish/tag/notice-send left operator-gated. Verified every changelog claim against the tree before writing it

Authored s3-uat-walk.md (5 Look, 3 Decide). Found the walk was unstageable as specified: the Getting Started form renders ONLY when a workspace has zero materialized sets, and the fixture workspace ships four, so the tier-fork absence could not be looked at. Added --empty to the walk stager (+3 Layer 2 tests) and an arg passthrough to walk:smoke, then PROVED it: npm run walk:smoke -- --empty reports revealed dabblerSessionSetsContainer

Release-boundary matrix green after freeze: pytest 3603 passed / 9 skipped (16m51s), mocha Layer 2 1606 passing, Playwright Layer 3 33 passed (10.3m). All three recorded via run_of_record; freshness check OK
Authored change-log.md (set-terminal deliverable) with the measured end-state numbers: 105 live non-archive files still MENTION the tier, 0 DECLARE it and that is now gated

Four rounds: discovery fan-out 2 (5 blocking) -> supplementary (1 blocking) -> remediation-review (4 accepted, 1 rejected, 1 new) -> remediation-review cycle 2 (7 accepted, 1 new). All 8 findings accepted and fixed; none disputed. The loop reached its ENFORCED bound at round 4 and refuses a fifth round: the round-4 fixes are in, tested and probed, but not independently re-read. Stopping to the operator for adjudication

Authored disposition.json (validates clean as the final session; verdict ISSUES_FOUND_RESOLVED_IN_FLIGHT -- all 8 findings found and fixed in flight, the last pair at the enforced bound). The disposition.uat block is the one field still owed: requiresUAT true + uatScope per-set puts the walk on this session, and it needs the operators attestation

Step 9 guidance review (run early, since the close is blocked on the operator walk): added L-112-1 (a gate that only ever passes proves nothing -- ship it with falsifiers), which passed the Set 085 admission test on this sessions evidence: the gate passed its own repo cleanly and still missed six declaration shapes over four rounds, every one found by planting rather than by reading. Adding it breached the lessons-learned ceiling by 23 tokens, so the lesson was TRIMMED rather than the ceiling raised (ceilings ratchet down only). Cited L-064-8, L-069-1, L-079-1, L-112-1; cite_lessons flags L-069-1 as archived-but-reused for operator reactivation review

Operator walked the guided-look UAT: PASS with one defect, found on the empty-project window the --empty stager mode made walkable. The System Status strip warned about a missing provider API key before any provider path had been chosen, because api is the DEFAULT profile and an explicit Direct-API pick is never written to disk. Fixed: the fault now also requires workspaceInitialized, which keeps it firing for keyless direct-API users; gating on a recorded choice was rejected because it would silence the fault for everyone it helps. Journaled, 4 Layer 2 cases + a Layer 3 falsifier, Layer 2 1609 passing and Layer 3 33 passed after the fix. Decides recorded: version 1.0.0, publish HELD until Set 114, consumer notice not needed

The close backstop refused the close and was right to. It found the engine bootstrap files (AGENTS/CLAUDE/GEMINI -- auto-loaded every session, preload) still teaching the state schema as applying on both Full and Lightweight tiers, which S2 missed, the gate cannot see by design (prose is narration), and three routed rounds never saw because the files were not in the diff. Fixed in all three and pinned by a direct-read test. Also three more declaration shapes (the field as a VALUE, a quoted name in a tuple, a returned mode literal) and one genuine leftover assertion about a deleted entry kind. pytest 3633 passed

Backstop round 6: a multiline list/tuple of mode literals slipped, because MODE_VALUE required an assigning prefix on the same line. Replaced the prefix rule with an exactness rule -- a quoted literal whose ENTIRE content is a mode name counts anywhere. The Playwright stale-marker test is still spared, now for a stated reason rather than by an exemption: dedicated-sessions plus a newline is file content, not a config value. 6/6 probes correct, guard suite 74 tests, pytest 3636 passed

Backstop round 7 found an unquoted YAML sequence. Changed tactic instead of adding a seventh prefix: in a DATA file (yaml/yml/json/md-fence) comments are already blanked, so anything left is content a machine reads -- the mode names now match bare in any position there, closing the whole class. Code keeps the exact-quoted rule, because code does hold incidental mentions. 5/5 probes correct including a YAML comment correctly spared. Guard suite 80 tests, pytest 3642 passed
